ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white lobes flanking a central black vertical column. Heavy black mottling and stippling are concentrated at the lower inner margins of the white areas and form a continuous border along the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a visible interior angle of approximately 30-35 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude serrations visible as a jagged pixel-boundary along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast tan/white textured circular clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; no visible amputations or large-scale physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense field of fine-grain black stippling located in the interior-lower quadrant of the right white lobe.
